### flag mut_sed_e_i
mut_sed_e_i() {
    sed -E -i "s/a/b/" "$ENV_FILE"
}
### flag mut_tee_a
mut_tee_a() {
    echo X=1 | tee -a "$ENV_FILE" >/dev/null
}
### flag mut_fd_append
mut_fd_append() {
    printf 'X=1\n' 1>>"$ENV_FILE"
}
### flag mut_cp
mut_cp() {
    cp "$tmp" "$ENV_FILE"
}
### flag mut_install
mut_install() {
    install -m 600 "$tmp" "$ENV_FILE"
}
### flag mut_mv_unquoted
mut_mv_unquoted() {
    mv -f $tmp "$ENV_FILE"
}
### flag mut_quoted_app_dir
mut_quoted_app_dir() {
    sed -i "s/a/b/" "$APP_DIR"/.env
}
### flag mut_alias
mut_alias() {
    local f="$ENV_FILE"
    sed -i "s/a/b/" "$f"
}
### flag mut_eval
mut_eval() {
    eval "sed -i s/a/b/ \"\$ENV_FILE\""
}
### flag mut_conditional_acquire
mut_conditional_acquire() {
    if [ -n "$x" ]; then
        acquire_node_env_lock || exit 1
    fi
    sed -i "s/a/b/" "$ENV_FILE"
}
### flag mut_acquire_or_true
mut_acquire_or_true() {
    acquire_node_env_lock || true
    sed -i "s/a/b/" "$ENV_FILE"
}
### flag mut_one_line
mut_one_line() { sed -i "s/a/b/" "$ENV_FILE"; }
### flag <top-level>
sed -i "s/a/b/" "$ENV_FILE"
### flag mut_clobber
mut_clobber() {
    printf 'X=1\n' >|"$ENV_FILE"
}
### flag mut_amp_redirect
mut_amp_redirect() {
    some_cmd &>"$ENV_FILE"
}
### flag mut_sed_in_place
mut_sed_in_place() {
    sed --in-place "s/a/b/" "$ENV_FILE"
}
### flag mut_persist_line
mut_persist_line() {
    persist_line "$ENV_FILE" "X=1"
}
### flag mut_truncate
mut_truncate() {
    truncate -s 0 "$ENV_FILE"
}
### flag mut_dd
mut_dd() {
    dd if="$tmp" of="$ENV_FILE" status=none
}
### flag mut_function_keyword
function mut_function_keyword {
    sed -i "s/a/b/" "$ENV_FILE"
}
### flag inner_writer
mut_nested_outer() {
    inner_writer() {
        sed -i "s/a/b/" "$ENV_FILE"
    }
    acquire_node_env_lock || return 1
    release_node_env_lock
}
### flag mut_plain
mut_plain() {
    sed -i "s/a/b/" "$ENV_FILE"
}
### flag mut_write_after_release
mut_write_after_release() {
    acquire_node_env_lock || return 1
    release_node_env_lock
    printf 'x\n' >>"$ENV_FILE"
}
### flag mut_unlocked_helper
mut_unlocked_helper() {
    apply_node_env_ssl_paths
}
### flag mut_unguarded_acquire
mut_unguarded_acquire() {
    acquire_node_env_lock
    sed -i "s/a/b/" "$ENV_FILE"
}
### flag mut_rm
mut_rm() {
    rm -f "$ENV_FILE"
}
### flag mut_chmod
mut_chmod() {
    chmod 644 "$ENV_FILE"
}
### flag mut_locked_direct_writes
mut_locked_direct_writes() {
    acquire_node_env_lock || return 1
    sed -E -i "s/a/b/" "$ENV_FILE"
    echo X=1 | tee -a "$ENV_FILE" >/dev/null
    cp "$tmp" "$ENV_FILE"
    mv -f $tmp "$ENV_FILE"
    sed -i "s/a/b/" "$APP_DIR"/.env
    printf 'X=1\n' >|"$ENV_FILE"
    dd if="$tmp" of="$ENV_FILE" status=none
    replace_node_env_file "$target" "$copy"
    if false; then
        release_node_env_lock
        rm -f "$scratch"
        exit 1
    fi
    echo x >>"$ENV_FILE"
    release_node_env_lock
}
### ok ok_if_not_acquire
ok_if_not_acquire() {
    if ! acquire_node_env_lock; then
        colorized_echo red "could not lock $ENV_FILE"
        exit 1
    fi
    node_env_write sed "s/a/b/"
    release_node_env_lock
}
### ok ok_block_scoped
ok_block_scoped() {
    if [ -n "$x" ]; then
        if ! acquire_node_env_lock; then
            exit 1
        fi
        node_env_write sed "s/a/b/"
        release_node_env_lock
    fi
}
### ok ok_reads
ok_reads() {
    [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ] || return 0
    grep -q '^A=' "$ENV_FILE"
    current=$(grep -E '^B=' "$ENV_FILE" | head -n1 | sed "s/^B=//")
    cat "$ENV_FILE" >"$scratch"
    cmp -s "$ENV_FILE" "$scratch"
    while read -r line; do :; done <"$ENV_FILE"
    colorized_echo red "Environment file not found at $ENV_FILE"
    printf '%s\n' "${ENV_FILE}.lock"
}
### flag mut_other_dir_var
mut_other_dir_var() {
    local d="$APP_DIR"
    sed -i "s/a/b/" "$d/.env"
}
### flag mut_literal_path
mut_literal_path() {
    sed -i "s/a/b/" /opt/pg-node/.env
}
### flag mut_relative_path
mut_relative_path() {
    cd "$APP_DIR" || return 1
    sed -i "s/a/b/" .env
}
### flag mut_find_delete
mut_find_delete() {
    find "$APP_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -name '.env' -delete
}
### flag mut_xargs
mut_xargs() {
    printf '%s\0' "$ENV_FILE" | xargs -0 sed -i "s/a/b/"
}
### flag mut_background
mut_background() {
    acquire_node_env_lock || return 1
    nohup sed -i "s/a/b/" "$ENV_FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    release_node_env_lock
}
### flag mut_background_helper
mut_background_helper() {
    acquire_node_env_lock || return 1
    replace_node_env_file "$target" "$copy" &
    release_node_env_lock
}
### flag mut_env_lib_helper
mut_env_lib_helper() {
    replace_or_append_env_var "X" "1"
}
### flag mut_background_block
mut_background_block() {
    acquire_node_env_lock || return 1
    (
        sed -i "s/a/b/" "$ENV_FILE"
    ) &
    release_node_env_lock
}
### ok ok_names_without_writing
ok_names_without_writing() {
    colorized_echo blue "Fetching .env and compose file"
    curl -fsSL --max-time 60 "$FILES_URL_PREFIX/.env.example" -o "$stage/env.example"
    find "$APP_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -name '.env.example' -print
    some_command >"$log" 2>&1
    wait_for_something &
    grep -q '^A=' "$APP_DIR/.env" 2>/dev/null
    printf '%s\n' "$ENV_FILE" | grep -q .
}
### ok ok_locked_helper_writes
ok_locked_helper_writes() {
    acquire_node_env_lock || return 1
    node_env_write sed "s/a/b/"
    node_env_write append_unless '^X=' "X= 1"
    node_env_write copy_from "$stage/env.example" || die "Could not write $APP_DIR/.env"
    node_env_write harden
    node_env_write replace "$working" "$target"
    node_env_write move_in "$staged"
    if false; then
        release_node_env_lock
        rm -f "$scratch"
        exit 1
    fi
    node_env_write sed "s/c/d/"
    release_node_env_lock
}
### ok ok_locked_context
ok_locked_context() {
    acquire_node_env_lock || return 1
    apply_node_env_ssl_paths
    release_node_env_lock
}
### ok ok_names_env_in_data
ok_names_env_in_data() {
    cat >"$unit" <<EOF
EnvironmentFile=$ENV_FILE
EOF
    cp -p "$ENV_FILE" "$before"
    staged=$(create_temp_file_in_dir "$dir" ".${target_name}.transaction.staged" "")
    backup_path="${source_dir}/.${source_name}.transaction.$$.$RANDOM"
    tar -czf "$backup" -C "$APP_DIR" .
    cp "$tmp" "$APP_DIR/docker-compose.yml"
}
### flag mut_helper_unlocked
mut_helper_unlocked() {
    node_env_write sed "s/a/b/"
}
### flag mut_helper_after_release
mut_helper_after_release() {
    acquire_node_env_lock || return 1
    release_node_env_lock
    node_env_write sed "s/a/b/"
}
### flag mut_helper_conditional_acquire
mut_helper_conditional_acquire() {
    if [ -n "$x" ]; then
        acquire_node_env_lock || exit 1
    fi
    node_env_write sed "s/a/b/"
}
### flag mut_helper_acquire_or_true
mut_helper_acquire_or_true() {
    acquire_node_env_lock || true
    node_env_write sed "s/a/b/"
}
### flag mut_helper_background
mut_helper_background() {
    acquire_node_env_lock || return 1
    node_env_write sed "s/a/b/" &
    release_node_env_lock
}
### flag mut_helper_unknown_action
mut_helper_unknown_action() {
    acquire_node_env_lock || return 1
    node_env_write truncate
    release_node_env_lock
}
### flag mut_replace_outside_helper
mut_replace_outside_helper() {
    acquire_node_env_lock || return 1
    replace_node_env_file "$target" "$copy"
    release_node_env_lock
}
### flag mut_positional_helper
mut_positional_helper() {
    sed -i "s/a/b/" "$1/.env"
}
### flag mut_dot_slash
mut_dot_slash() {
    cd "$APP_DIR" || return 1
    sed -i "s/a/b/" ./.env
}
### flag mut_expansion_default
mut_expansion_default() {
    sed -i "s/a/b/" "${ENV_FILE:-/opt/pg-node/.env}"
}
### flag mut_expansion_suffix
mut_expansion_suffix() {
    sed -i "s/a/b/" "${ENV_FILE%.bak}"
}
### flag mut_expansion_required
mut_expansion_required() {
    sed -i "s/a/b/" "${ENV_FILE:?}"
}
### flag mut_indirect
mut_indirect() {
    local var=ENV_FILE
    sed -i "s/a/b/" "${!var}"
}
### flag mut_dirname_subst
mut_dirname_subst() {
    sed -i "s/a/b/" "$(dirname "$ENV_FILE")/.env"
}
### flag mut_mv_into_app_dir
mut_mv_into_app_dir() {
    mv -f "$stage/.env" "$APP_DIR/"
}
### flag mut_cp_into_app_dir
mut_cp_into_app_dir() {
    cp "$stage/.env" "$APP_DIR"
}
### flag mut_tar_into_app_dir
mut_tar_into_app_dir() {
    tar -xzf "$bundle" -C "$APP_DIR"
}
### flag mut_heredoc_to_bash
mut_heredoc_to_bash() {
    bash <<EOS
sed -i "s/a/b/" "$ENV_FILE"
EOS
}
### flag mut_heredoc_piped_to_sh
mut_heredoc_piped_to_sh() {
    cat <<EOS | sh
sed -i "s/a/b/" "$ENV_FILE"
EOS
}
### flag mut_name_from_parts
mut_name_from_parts() {
    local suffix=env
    sed -i "s/a/b/" "$APP_DIR/.$suffix"
}
### flag mut_glob
mut_glob() {
    sed -i "s/a/b/" "$APP_DIR"/.en?
}
### flag mut_brace
mut_brace() {
    sed -i "s/a/b/" "$APP_DIR"/.{env,none}
}
### flag mut_rsync_into_app_dir
mut_rsync_into_app_dir() {
    rsync -a "$stage/" "$APP_DIR/"
}
### flag mut_calls_panel_lib_writer
mut_calls_panel_lib_writer() {
    write_backup_settings
}
### flag mut_shell_eval
mut_shell_eval() {
    eval "$command_text"
}
### flag mut_timeout_wrapper
mut_timeout_wrapper() {
    timeout 5 sed -i "s/a/b/" "$ENV_FILE"
}
### flag mut_timeout_signal_wrapper
mut_timeout_signal_wrapper() {
    timeout -s KILL 5 sed -i "s/a/b/" "$ENV_FILE"
}
